newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai forex market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai forex market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market was closed on Monday because of a National Day holiday, an exchange official said. Trading will resume on Thursday.
On Saturday, the last trading day, the Chinese yuan closed unchanged at 8.3017 in very dull trading against the U.S. dollar.
It closed at 7.5000 against 100 Japanese yen, from 7.4858, and at 1.0724 against the Hong Kong dollar, compared with 1.0727.
